39:32.text: Then, who does more wrong than one who utters a lie against Allâh,
[this Qur’ân, the Prophet (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and the Islâmic Monotheism]
when it comes to him! Is there not in Hell an abode for the disbelievers?

39:33.text: (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)

39:34.text: They shall have all that they will desire with their Lord. That is the reward of Muhsinûn

39:35.text: So that Allâh may expiate from them the evil of what they did and give them the reward, according to the best of what they used to do.

39:36.text: Is not Allâh Sufficient for His slave? Yet they try to frighten you with those
besides Him! And whom Allâh sends astray, for him there will be no guide.

39:37.text: And whomsoever Allâh guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allâh All-Mighty, Possessor of Retribution?

39:38.text: And verily, if you ask them: "Who created the heavens and the earth?" Surely they will say: "Allâh
." Say: "Tell me then, the things that you invoke besides Allâh - if Allâh intended some harm for me, could they remove His harm? Or if He
intended some mercy for me, could they withhold His Mercy?" Say: "Sufficient for me is Allâh; in Him those who trust

39:39.text: "O My people! Work according to your way, I am working
. Then you will come to know

39:40.text: "To whom comes a disgracing torment, and on whom descends an everlasting torment."
